fact.subject: Dropbox
fact.object: Tigris Data and DBX Agent Cloud object storage

evidence.quote: Dropbox is making a big push into AI infrastructure with a $350 million acquisition of cloud technology company Tigris Data, marking what appears to be its largest acquisition to date.
Dropbox told TechCrunch via email that the transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026.

title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
displayTitle: Dropbox拟以3.5亿美元收购Tigris，切入Agent对象存储
summary: TechCrunch报道Dropbox宣布以3.5亿美元收购Tigris Data，计划用其云存储技术支撑DBX Agent Cloud；公司预计2026年第四季度完成交易，初期提供兼容S3的独立对象存储。
investorNote: Agent基础设施争夺开始落在存储和跨区域数据访问，交易尚未交割，不能写成已整合。
narrative: Dropbox宣布以3.5亿美元收购Tigris Data，目标是建设DBX Agent Cloud的存储底座；据报道交易预计第四季度完成，首阶段是可独立购买、兼容S3工具的对象存储。投资人应关注它能否把现有文件协作优势迁移为Agent的数据层，而不是把宣布交易等同于产品已经成熟。

eventRelation.reason: 新宣布的Tigris交易，与其他基础设施并购不同。
